name: Protein Oats
subtitle: Packed with Protein, Naturally Sweetened and Ready in Minutes!

description:
🍫 Super Protein Oats is a quick and nutritious breakfast for Kids crafted from whole-grain oats, nuts, and plant protein.

✅ Sweetened with jaggery and dates  (no refined sugar), it’s quick and satisfying served hot or cold. 

A 40 g serve with 200 ml milk delivers a deliciously crunchy 12g protein start to the day.
Mix 40 g with 200 ml warm/hot/cold milk and serve.

howToUse: Mix 40 g with 200 ml warm/hot/cold milk and serve.

reviews.author: Jhanvi Shetty.
reviews.title: Breakfast battles are over!
reviews.body: Protein + chocolate that my child actually finishes!

reviews.author: Manisha
reviews.title: Perfect for hectic mornings.
reviews.body: Between packing lunchboxes and catching the school bus, breakfast needs to be fast, and this is ready in minutes. My son loves it cold with milk, and I love the clean ingredients. Definitely stocking up!

reviews.author: Nehali Jain
reviews.title: Morning chaos solved.
reviews.body: Between school runs and office calls, breakfast used to be stressful. These protein oats are quick, filling, and my son loves the chocolatey taste. Sometimes we make it cold overnight and it’s even better.

reviews.author: Saloni
reviews.title: Great for kids with a sweet tooth!
reviews.body: My twins are chocolate lovers, and this feels like a treat but is actually nutritious. Just wish there were bigger packs available.

reviews.author: Miloni Sharma
reviews.title: Healthy habit, zero fuss!
reviews.body: Ready in minutes and keeps my 8-year-old full till lunch. Love that it has jaggery and dates instead of sugar. Would love more flavor options too.
